correctness.rationale: The trivalent connected graph has 30 vertices and 45 edges, hence arithmetic genus 45−30+1=16; stable P1 components have no automorphisms fixing all three branch marks, so the full curve automorphism group is the graph group. A unique PGL2 map of triples lifts every graph automorphism over any field, giving constant Aut; procyclic finite-field H^1 identifies forms with conjugacy classes. Independent construction from all duads and perfect matchings of six labels and graph isomorphism enumeration produced exactly 1440 automorphisms (720 S6 plus a side-swapping coset), 13 conjugacy classes, 11 orbit/zeta signatures and point-free classes of orders 5 and 10. For each extension field, normalizing 30 components gives (q^n+1) fixed component contributions, plus fixed nodes minus fixed branches; multiply orbit factors Z(T)=∏(1−T^d)^(b_d−v_d−e_d)/(1−q^d T^d)^(v_d). Group computation is finite exact, and descent/normalization establish all finite fields.
